summary: Feed s070_single is degraded due to payload slicing: 8.3% of frames (183/2201) truncated to ~256 bytes, exceeding 5% threshold. NDR requires full payload for detection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, drops, overload, encryption, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is configured with slicing/packet truncation at 256 bytes, likely to conserve bandwidth or tool port capacity. This cuts off L4 payload before it reaches the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep packet inspection, signature matching, and anomaly detection. Truncated frames hide application payload, preventing detection of exploits, C2, and data exfiltration in the sliced flows.

recommended_fix.why: NDR profile requires needs_full_payload=true. Disabling slicing restores complete frames so NDR can analyze full payload and improve detection coverage.
